<thought>To locate a suitable retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using only the functional group criteria that are definitely valid: the forward reaction breaks a ketone and a C‑C double bond, and forms an aliphatic hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring. Providing just these criteria should return matching templates without causing parsing errors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"],
    "limit": 5
}
